title: The Requesting the Gentler Song
youtube_title: The Requesting the Gentler Song | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Quinn feels shy about requesting the gentler song at the end. Instead of pretending not to care, Quinn tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
